kelly.name: Kelly
kelly.summary: Local-first focus accountability system. AI judges your progress against your goals and punishes you for falling behind.

on-device.text: Logs app and input activity; data stays on your machine

ai-judge.text: A local model or your own API key scores you against your goals

nerdiest-dungeon.name: The Nerdiest Dungeon
nerdiest-dungeon.summary: Pixel-art roguelike RPG that the only way to make your character is to study.

study-levelup.text: Solving questions or watching videos increases your character's stats

study-combat.text: Monsters are question sets, correct answers cast skills

spaced-repetition.text: Items expire unless you solve related review questions

what-to-cook.name: What To Cook
what-to-cook.summary: Recipe platform that suggests dishes from what you have.

recipes.text: Dish ideas and sourced recipes from on-hand ingredients

ops.text: Ran live with GitHub Actions, Jest e2e tests, and Sentry alerts

auth.text: Google, Facebook, Twitter, and email, with JWT sessions
